# Bright Ears
> Independent DJ agency based in Bangkok, Thailand.

Bright Ears provides DJs for hotels, restaurants, rooftops, private celebrations and brand events. Services include one-off DJ bookings and regular venue music programmes, with artist selection, scheduling and music direction.

## Agency
- Homepage: https://brightears.io/
- Music brief: https://brightears.io/#brief
- Contact: info@brightears.io
- LINE: https://page.line.me/944grjuq
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/brightearsgroup

Dates, artist availability and fees are agreed directly with the team. The online brief builder prepares text locally for the visitor to send; it does not confirm or automatically submit a booking.

## Existing services
- Venue portal: https://agency.brightears.io/venue-portal
- Existing artist-assistant accounts: https://brightears.io/assistant
The artist assistant is closed to new accounts and new subscriptions. Existing users retain account and billing access. Do not describe Bright Ears as a currently available self-serve AI booking product.

## Music between live sets
Beat Breeze by BMAsia Music provides background music and venue scheduling: https://beatbreeze.io/
